description: This file defines the ConditionalExpression class in the Twig templating engine, implementing a conditional (ternary) expression node with compilation logic.

classes.name: ConditionalExpression
classes.description: Represents a conditional (ternary) expression node in Twig's abstract syntax tree, supporting compilation to PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the conditional expression node with three sub-expressions and the line number, issuing a deprecation warning.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code, handling both the Elvis operator case and the full ternary operator case.

methods.name: getOperandNamesToEscape
methods.description: Returns the list of operand node names that should be escaped during compilation.
